name: Bloody Ragdoll Physics 🩸
desc:
💥 Every dummy is a real physics body. Hit it, throw it, blow it up and watch what happens.

They stumble, beg, fight back and fall the way they were hit. Limbs come off, and no two falls look the same.

🔫 23 WEAPONS
Sniper, shotgun, chainsaw, sledgehammer, flamethrower, minigun, rocket launcher, gravity gun and a black hole

💉 14 SYRINGES
Zombies that bite, ragdolls that explode, ragdolls that blow up like balloons, and a pink one nobody understands

🚗 DRIVE CARS
Crash them, or get in and watch a dummy go through the windshield

⚔️ NPC WARS
Pick the teams, hand out weapons, press go

🌍 WORLD EVENTS
Nuke, Black Hole, Fire Storm, Zero-G, Flash Freeze

🛠️ SANDBOX
Spawn anything, bend the rules, slow time down, rewind it

🎮 Play on PC, phone and console. ⭐ Like and favorite for updates!

llm.loop: spawn dummies -> hit, shoot, blow up and drive into them -> watch physics ragdolls -> unlock weapons, syringes, world events
llm.objectives: cause creative mayhem with ragdoll dummies
llm.instructions: hit, throw and blow up dummies; use 23 weapons, 14 syringes, cars, NPC wars, world events, slow motion/rewind
unique: dismemberment ragdolls that react to hit location
llm.thumbnails: white dummies flying in explosions, dummy with gun, pickup truck hitting dummy
llm.complexity_notes: active ragdoll with limb loss, many weapons/syringes, events, rewind
